topic: Describing Motion Using Distance, Time, and Speed
key_concepts: Motion is a change in position from a reference point
A reference point is a stationary object used to determine movement
Distance measures how far an object travels and is measured with ruler, meter stick, or ta
Time measures the duration of movement and is measured with stopwatch or watch
Speed describes how fast or slow an object moves
Speed is calculated as distance divided by time
Common speed units include meters per second and kilometers per hour
Covering the same distance in less time means greater speed
The formula triangle can be used to find speed, distance, or time
Accurate measurements are important for describing motion
